description: Windkraftanlagen der Stadt Bremerhaven is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The database contains the point data on operated wind turbines and measuring masts in the city of Bremerhaven. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines of the city of Bremerhaven" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Energieresourcen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
